name: How do I prevent future damage to interior paint after touch-ups?

mainEntity.name: How do I prevent future damage to interior paint after touch-ups?

acceptedAnswer.text: Preventing future damage to your interior paint after touch-ups involves a few simple practices. Use furniture pads to prevent scrapes from moving items. Install wall protectors or door stoppers to guard against impacts. For high-traffic areas, consider more durable paint finishes like satin or semi-gloss, which are more resistant to scuffs and easier to clean than flat paints. Regularly cleaning walls with a soft cloth and mild soap can also extend the life of your paint job and reduce the need for frequent touch-ups. Being mindful of how furniture and objects interact with walls significantly helps.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prevent damage with furniture pads, wall protectors, and door stoppers. Use durable paint finishes in high-traffic areas and clean walls regularly.
